title: Brazilian Inspired Stir Fry
description: A light and romantic stir fry dish with Brazilian flair, featuring the flavors of ginger and a variety of spices.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of coconut oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced ginger and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the sliced red bell pepper and red onion, and cook for 3-4 minutes, until tender.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the bamboo shoots and stir-fry sauce, and cook for 2-3 minutes, until the sauce is bubbly and the shoots are coated.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
